senses.gloss: lekhanā (cf. Skt. and Pali ˚na, nt.), (act of) writing: Mvy 〔903〕 (in sense of copying sacred works).

lekha-lipi, a kind of writing, Senart epistolary, i.e. cursive writing: Mv 〔i.135.6〕; lekha-pratilekha-lipi LV 〔126.6〕, in passage corresp. to Mv; Tib. literally, script for sending a letter and return (reply), spriṅ yig daṅ lan gyi yi ge.
lekhahārika (cf. Skt. ˚hāraka, ˚hārin), courier, letter-carrier: Mvy 〔3817〕. Cf. s.v. lehari(ka).
